This maize plot is small, and I have to be careful with what I buy. Because maize does better with some fertilizer and we are in the North West, I will use a little chemical fertilizer, but not too much, and I will also put some manure if I can get it. I will keep using the seed I know, depend on rain, and mostly use family labor, with only a few hired hands if the work becomes heavy.
